description: Use to verify any escrow deal onchain: open, settled or cancelled, and whether buyer and seller have funded. Public, no signature needed. Returns the deal state read from the contract.

chain.description: robinhood (default), base, elysium or solana. Deal ids are per chain: pass the chain the deal was opened on.

dealId.description: Deal number from the DealCreated event.

escrow.description: Optional: the escrow contract the deal lives on, as listed in bull_stats recent[].escrow. Needed only for a deal on an earlier (retired) escrow: deal numbers restart at 1 on every escrow. Default: the current escrow.

name: bull_get_deal
